description: Per-rest heart-rate recovery of one guided gym session: the FIT's record-level HR joined to the guide's lap labels (compare_workout_to_plan's mapping; a status other than 'ok' returns empty rests). Per rest: peakHr, endHr (mean of the last 5 s), dropTotal, t10S/t20S/t30S (seconds after the peak until smoothed HR first fell 10/20/30 bpm; null if never), recoveryBpmPerMin, coverage. peakHr is the highest smoothed value from 15 s before the rest to 30 s after its start (optical HR lags). Samples outside 30-230 bpm are ignored; a rest with under 5 samples returns nulls plus a note. hrQuality.reliable is false for gaps (under 80% covered), out-of-range samples (over 2%), a flat value over 180 s or frequent jumps over 40 bpm; numbers are still returned, best effort. perExercise strength guides have no rests. How the rest windows line up with the FIT timeline was not checked on a real workout (alignment.startSkewS; reliable is false beyond 10 s); whether FIT files carry SuuntoPlus developer fields is unverified. Downloads the ~550 KB FIT. Read-only.

plan.description: Optional: the exercises array given to push_strength_guide or push_workout_guide, as-is.

workoutKey.description: 24-hex id from list_workouts; anything else fails with not-found.
